email_composer.pgp_attachments_blocked: Attach files inside the encrypted editor. Files added here would be uploaded unencrypted.
email_composer.close_pgp_message: Encrypted messages are never saved to the server. Closing discards this message.
email_composer.pgp_no_identity: Cannot send an encrypted message without a sender identity.

pgp.title: PGP encryption
pgp.description: Read and send PGP-encrypted mail with the Mailvelope browser extension. Your keys and passphrases stay inside the extension: Bulwark never sees them.
pgp.keys_description: Generate, import and manage keys here. Messages are encrypted with your contacts' public keys and decrypted with your private key, both inside Mailvelope.
pgp.keys_embed_failed: The embedded key manager could not be loaded.
pgp.open_settings_failed: Could not open the Mailvelope settings.
pgp.limits_title: What is and is not encrypted
pgp.limits_body: The subject, sender, recipients and date stay readable, as in every PGP/MIME message. Encrypted messages are never saved as drafts on the server. Signing without encrypting is not available through Mailvelope.

pgp.encrypt_on: PGP encryption is on. Click to turn it off
pgp.sign_on: Signing is on. Click to encrypt without signing
pgp.sign_off: Also sign with your PGP key
pgp.banner_title: This message will be encrypted with PGP
pgp.banner_title_signed: This message will be encrypted and signed with PGP
pgp.banner_cleartext_notice: The subject, sender and recipients are not encrypted.
pgp.banner_drafts_notice: Nothing is saved to the server while PGP is on, so closing discards the message.
pgp.banner_attachments_notice: Attach files with the button inside the encrypted editor.
pgp.recipient_importable: Key found online, not imported yet
pgp.send_blocked_hint: Sending is blocked until every recipient has a key. Import their public key in Mailvelope, or remove them.
pgp.enable_blocked_attachments: Remove the attachments before encrypting. Files added here are uploaded unencrypted; use the attach button inside the encrypted editor instead.
pgp.enable_draft_message: This draft is stored on the server as plain text. Turning on encryption deletes it from the server. The text you have typed moves into the encrypted editor.
pgp.enable_draft_failed: Could not delete the saved draft, so encryption was not turned on.
pgp.disable_message: The text in the encrypted editor cannot be carried back and will be discarded.
pgp.sign_switch_message: Signing is fixed when the editor starts. Switching restarts it and discards what you have typed in it.
pgp.editor_failed: Could not start the encrypted editor: {message}
pgp.editor_failed_short: The encrypted editor could not be started.
pgp.editor_not_ready: The encrypted editor is still loading.
pgp.send_blocked_failed: Recipient keys could not be checked. Use Check again.
pgp.undo_kept_draft: Sending was stopped. The encrypted message was kept in Drafts.
pgp.error_frame_blocked: The encrypted editor is blocked by this site's security policy. Its Content-Security-Policy must allow chrome-extension: and moz-extension: in frame-src.
pgp.error_invalid_address: Cannot encrypt: {address} is not a valid email address.
pgp.error_non_ascii_address: Cannot encrypt: {address} uses non-ASCII characters, which needs a server that supports SMTPUTF8.
pgp.error_no_key_for_recipient: No PGP key was found for one of the recipients.
pgp.error_no_own_key: You have no private key to sign with. Generate or import one in Mailvelope.
pgp.error_quota: The message is too large to encrypt.
pgp.error_disconnected: The connection to Mailvelope was lost. Reload the page and try again.
pgp.display_failed: This message could not be opened with Mailvelope.
pgp.display_note: Decrypted by Mailvelope. The signature status is shown inside the message frame.
